product.olivetti-lsx-5050.summary: The LSX Olivetti Canada chose for the Canadian foreign service network.
product.olivetti-lsx-5050.history: In January 1993, L’Unità reported that Olivetti Canada would install more than 200 Unix-based LSX 5050 servers for the Canadian foreign affairs department.
product.olivetti-lsx-5050.architecture: The platform had to be selected for multiprocessor use. SCO identifies the LSX 5050 as a multiprocessor option in the UnixWare 2 installer.
product.olivetti-lsx-5050.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5050.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
